INSERT INTO pools
                (pool_address, protocol, token_a_mint, token_b_mint,
                 first_seen_at, last_seen_at)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $5)
            ON CONFLICT (pool_address) DO UPDATE
                SET last_seen_at = GREATEST(pools.last_seen_at, EXCLUDED.last_seen_at)
